name: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko wa Erotuber!
original_name: 気になるあの娘はえろちゅーばー!
source:
The main character "Nishi Eita", with his sharp intuition and passion for streamers, discovers that his classmate "Yume Harukawa" is a famous singer-streamer. While trying to use the secret to get closer, Eita also meets other streamers through Yume.

Ritsu Shinonome is a friend of Yume and a V-streamer. Yuuka Asaki is the wife of a neighbor and live-streamer of retro games.

As he became involved with the three girls, Eita began to feel that he wanted to support them more than anyone else.

But if anyone finds out about his relationship with the female streamers, everything will fall apart!

How will the "Secret romance" that can't be discovered turn out...!?

[from [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/switch/404329-bishoujo-streamer-no-himitsu-renai-secret-romance]GameFaqs[/url]]
